title: Reject a relative global-oracle interpretation of marginal regret
statement: The received comparison uses C_N(D)=r sum E[A ell(D E_(t,h))],which can be q times a correlated global Pauli loss. A whole-channel discrepancy nu does not freely move this sum to the imperfect controller’s changed occupation;an additional q-scale comparator debit may be required.

Same complete causal CPTP source port for probe and payload,private current roles/coins/receiver controls and padded schedule
Full joint payload/reference initially independent of source memory and acquisition randomness;trusted holding and isolated delivered outputs
Fixed encoder;actual exploratory receiver on every active call;all q unknown inputs initially jointly independent of source memory
provides: An explicit incompatibility boundary for downstream reuse
assumptions: Zero common-oracle subfamily can still give useful joint reliability
Common CP-order structure is supplied,not learned
No relative global-oracle or per-record confidence theorem
costs: All source calls,actual instruments,finite rational updates/sampling,receiver synthesis,routing,resets,storage and waiting time are paid
One complete implementation discrepancy is relative to the declared ideal trusted-interface occupation;it does not freely move a cumulative comparator to changed imperfect histories
N=O_tilde((q+log(1/epsilon))d^5/(gamma epsilon));all actual calls include payload attempts
Trusted storage of q inputs and isolated outputs;2q private framing bits if framing is used
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: A global channel bound and a cumulative occupation comparator are different objects.

body: The comparator is a fixed decoder’s cumulative PER-USE MARGINAL loss on the ideal trusted-interface mixed occupation,not an oracle global channel loss or another policy’s trajectory. Whole-q implementation discrepancy transfers the service guarantee,not that comparator to imperfect histories. This is a finite service with paid storage/controls,not independent product channels or indefinite reuse. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
